title: Cheapest product per category
statementMd:
For each category show the cheapest product (name and price).

Expected columns: `category`, `name`, `price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare to `MIN(price)` in the same category.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT p.category, p.name, p.price FROM products p WHERE p.price = (SELECT MIN(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category = p.category);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
